comments.note: Directory.Packages.props uses Unicode box-drawing characters (U+2500 '─') in its ItemGroup comment separators. Care must be taken when editing the file via PowerShell string replacement — the -NoNewline flag can cause issues on multi-line strings and any comment containing '--' sequences is invalid XML. Future comment additions should use box-drawing characters or single hyphens only.

Program.cs: The AddSingleton<LibVLC>() registration uses the default constructor (no options). If VLC startup flags are needed in the future (e.g. --no-video-title-show, hardware decoding options), the registration lambda will need updating. A comment near the registration would guide future contributors.
